newsitem.title: USA: United Biomedical HIV tests get FDA approval.
newsitem.headline: United Biomedical HIV tests get FDA approval.

text.p: United Biomedical Inc said on Friday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration granted the company a license to manufacture a test for the HIV virus.
The privately held company said the test was based on synthetic peptides and detected antibodies to AIDS virus types 1 and 2 (HIV-1, 2).
United Biomedical said its test yielded results quicker since the sample was incubated for a shorter period of time.
It said the test was suitable for diagnostic laboratories and blood donor screening, and required anywhere from a half hour to an hour and a half less time than other tests.
